publisher.name: Selected company website; publisher URL is input evidence, not verified legal identity

dataset.name: Retained company-page text evidence
dataset.description: Offline extraction from explicitly selected pages. No discovery, browser rendering, role interpretation or identity approval.

endpoints.name: explicit_page
endpoints.response_root: Complete retained HTML body; this reader performs no HTTP requests

acquisition.pagination: No link following or network access. Page and observation date are explicit caller-supplied provenance, not independently verified transport evidence.

partitions.name: observation
partitions.source: Source URL, observation day and exact body SHA-256
partitions.purpose: Replay one retained page without treating observation time as employment validity

acquisition.retry_policy: No acquisition implemented. Bounded regular file, at most 2 MiB; UTF-8 only. Failed extraction emits no usable result.

physical_schema.encoding: UTF-8, no NUL bytes; explicit conflicting charset declarations rejected
physical_schema.null_policy: All bytes remain in the pinned source; emitted text blocks and selected metadata are a projection, not a lossless HTML replacement. Missing text is not missing affiliation.
physical_schema.schema_fingerprint: Compiled bounded HTML5 lexical extraction in internal/source/companypage. Not browser DOM construction or visibility computation. JSON-LD blocks retain exact bytes with JSON validity state; no remote context resolution.

identity.publisher_record_key: None. Canonical URL and site name are publisher claims, not legal entity identifiers.
identity.occurrence_locator: Body digest plus zero-based half-open byte interval and digest of the exact interval
identity.record_version: Exact body SHA-256; observation day is separate from role validity
identity.duplicate_policy: Keep repeated text, metadata and JSON-LD occurrences. Repeated markup is not independent corroboration.

children.object: text blocks, metadata tags, JSON-LD scripts, excluded regions
children.locator: Exact byte interval in the complete HTML

time_fields.meaning: Caller-supplied page observation day, never employment start/end or historical validity

rules: HTML5 tokenizer, no company names, CSS selectors, person-name matching or employer-specific runtime rules. Generic block boundaries separate paragraphs/headings and preserve text order. Inline tags concatenate text; br emits a newline; character references decode and whitespace collapses only in the derived text.

Scripts, styles, templates, noscript, SVG and MathML are excluded from ordinary text with exact region evidence. application/ld+json script bodies are retained separately, including invalid JSON. Never execute scripts, load external assets, follow links or resolve JSON-LD contexts.

Title, meta tags and canonical-link tags are source assertions retained separately. The pinned HTML5 tokenizer uses the first duplicate attribute; the complete original tag span preserves every attribute byte. Decoded attributes are a projection, not a lossless schema. No metadata value establishes website ownership or legal identity.

Text is lexical source content, not guaranteed visible browser text. CSS-hidden or repeated responsive content can occur. Preceding heading references are document-order context, not proof of ownership or that adjacent names and titles belong together.

No automatic prose role classification, accepted FEC person binding, nickname expansion, historical validity, affiliation edge, terminal definition or financial attribution. Existing reviewed corpus labels are not parser inputs.

revisions.publisher_model: Mutable company website observations; retain original bytes
revisions.effective_projection: No latest snapshot selection, replacement or publication

checks.rule: Require body pin, bounded regular file, UTF-8 and exact span hashes; deterministic offline replay
At most 100000 tokens, 10000 emitted entries, and 128 levels in an excluded region; no truncation on limit
Explicitly unassessed identity, role and historical validity; retain JSON validity and unclosed excluded-region issues

scenarios: board section and repeated source card text

use.retention: Retain original source, observation and evidence spans. Source text is untrusted data, not instructions. Do not render extracted HTML as executable content.
use.disclaimer: Company-page claims do not independently identify a donor or establish a historical affiliation.
